Vancouver, British Columbia--(Newsfile Corp. - August 31, 2026) - RESAAS Services Inc.

(OTCID: RSASF) ("RESAAS" or "the Company"), a technology company modernizing referrals, payments, and data exchange across the global real estate industry, today announced its financial results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026. The Company delivered a record revenue quarter, achieved net profitability for the fourth consecutive quarter, and expanded its enterprise data exchange, underscoring the growing commercial validation of its platform.

Databricks Integration for Enterprise Data - April 23, 2026

RESAAS announced the launch of a Databricks integration, enabling enterprise customers to securely synchronize proprietary real estate data captured within RESAAS directly into Databricks' AI Platform. This capability allows customers to combine RESAAS referral, transaction, and market intelligence data with their own internal datasets, supporting advanced analytics, business intelligence, and AI-driven decision-making.

Epique Realty, one of the fastest growing brokerages in the United States, selected RESAAS to power its referral platform. The agreement expands RESAAS' presence among premium residential brokerages and reinforces the Company's strategy of enabling cross-border collaboration and agent-to-agent referral activity at scale.

The Company expanded its Commercial Data Exchange (CODE) to the Toronto, ON market during Q2, servicing the Office and Industrial asset classes for existing clients of RESAAS CODE, as well as additional brokerage and institutional customers in and around the Greater Toronto Area.

"Q2 2026 was another landmark quarter for the Company. RESAAS more than tripled revenue year-over-year, delivered a fourth consecutive profitable quarter, and continued to secure agreements with enterprise clients across both residential and commercial real estate verticals," said

. "RESAAS's continual investment in platform infrastructure and data capabilities is enabling the Company to scale at an accelerating rate. This quarter marks the first inclusion of revenue from transaction fees, a channel we expect to grow significantly."

RESAAS enters the second half of 2026 with a growing roster of global enterprise clients, a differentiated and expanding technology platform, and a strengthened balance sheet. The Company believes its three-pillar strategy - enterprise referral technology, purpose-built payment infrastructure through RESAAS Pay, and commercial real estate data exchange - provides multiple pathways to long-term revenue growth, platform scalability, and operating leverage.
Key growth drivers anticipated for the second half of 2026 and beyond include:
Continued onboarding of new enterprise customers and activation of contracted referral networks
Commercialization of RESAAS Pay, the Company's purpose-built payment rails for multi-currency real estate referral fee settlement
Revenue opportunities from the commercial real estate data exchange platform, designed for research departments within large commercial brokerages and institutional landlord-operators
Data monetization and analytics revenue enabled by integrations with SAP, Snowflake and Databricks, and expanded data intelligence opportunities under the newly appointed Director of Data Strategy

RESAAS is a technology company building infrastructure for the modern real estate industry. RESAAS provides enterprise software, commercial real estate data exchange and payment solutions that enable real estate organizations to securely connect, exchange data and transact.
The Company's platform is used by leading real estate organizations as a trusted infrastructure layer for the industry's increasingly data-driven economy.
Tom Rossiter, CEO, RESAAS Services Inc.
